Cooperation falls from 3 to 2: distinct Isp/Pac jobs and one handoff match the same rubric anchor used for level_02 and level_04; no repeated mutual dependency or required simultaneous coordination is present.
Timing changes from unknown to 1 because the ferry moves periodically after Isp leaves STOP, but the wide ferry and safe shore allow repeatable boarding rather than a narrow window.
Hazards changes from unknown to 2 because the mandatory crossing is over lethal slime, with a broad ferry and safe staging points.
Recovery changes from unknown to 2 because a fall causes a whole-room reset and repeats the short ordered setup, but route and human retry costs are not measured.
